_HOW_TO_ADD_A_KEY: 1. Copy one of the { } lines inside "keys".
2. Give it a new label (the customer name) and put the SHA-256 hash of the key there.
3. Set exp to a date like "2026-12-31T23:59:59.000Z", or null for a key that never expires.
4. Commit this file. Every app - including APKs people already installed - picks it up by itself.
To kill a key: move its hash into "revoked", or delete its entry. See ADD-LICENSE-KEY.md.
